name: pr1
setup: m.ui(true); m.stage0({s: 1.35}); m.simulate(1.0333); const A = m.dummy.root.position.clone(), T = m.tags[1].K.root.position.clone(); const d = T.clone().sub(A); d.y = 0; d.normalize(); const sx = -d.z, sz = d.x; const C = new T.constructor(T.x + d.x * 0.42 + sx * 0.06, 0.16, T.z + d.z * 0.42 + sz * 0.06); const dir = T.clone().sub(C).normalize(); const right = dir.clone().cross(new T.constructor(0,1,0)).normalize(); const a = Math.atan(0.5 * Math.tan(26 * Math.PI / 360)); dir.applyAxisAngle(right, a); const tg = C.clone().add(dir); v.pos = [C.x, C.y, C.z]; v.target = [tg.x, tg.y, tg.z];
